description: Holds yard details records (defined in the EF Core model), linked to raw material dimensions.
business_purpose: Used to track and report yard details records, including amounts and quantities, for the Factory & Inventory area.
record_granularity: One row represents one yard detail.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the yard detail.

columns.name: YardHeaderid
columns.description: Yard headerid of the yard detail.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.description: Soft-delete flag. True when the record has been deleted.

columns.name: rawmaterialdimensionsid
columns.description: Reference to the raw material dimensions linked to this yard detail.

relationships.description: Each yard detail references one raw material dimensions (rawmaterialdimensions).

business_rules: Deleted records (is_deleted = 1) should normally be excluded from reporting.
Use count for monetary or quantity totals.
Join to Raw Material Dimensions through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
YardDetails is defined in the EF Core model but was not found in the connected database, so it may not be deployed there.
common_queries: Yard Details by raw material dimensions
Top raw material dimensions by count

query_notes: Do not generate SQL against YardDetails: no table or view with this name exists in the connected database.
Always filter is_deleted = 0 unless deleted records are explicitly requested.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting yard detail records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(count) for totals of count.
To resolve names, join on: rawmaterialdimensionsid = RawMaterialDimensions.id.
Defined in the EF Core model but not found in the connected database; confirm it has been migrated before relying on it.
